subject: Civic Education
competence: Expresses views accepting the fact that fulfillment of duties and responsibilities of the public services institutions bring about the welfare of human beings.
lesson: Expresses views accepting the fact that fulfillment of duties and responsibilities of the public services institutions bring about the welfare of human beings: Teacher approach: show video for school students
unique_learning_outcome: Expresses views accepting the fact that fulfillment of duties and responsibilities of the public services institutions bring about the welfare of human beings.
the_entrance: 5-minute introduction: The teacher introduces the topic by asking students to share their experiences with public services institutions. Students discuss how these institutions impact their daily lives. The teacher then shows a video for school students that highlights the importance of public services institutions in bringing about the welfare of human beings. Students are encouraged to take notes and ask questions.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: The teacher explains the importance of public services institutions and their role in bringing about the welfare of human beings. Students are then divided into groups of 5 and assigned roles: Leader/Facilitator, Scribe/Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson/Presenter, and Civic Investigator/Inquirer.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students discuss and brainstorm ideas on how public services institutions bring about the welfare of human beings. They are encouraged to use the video as a reference and take notes on key points.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: The teacher facilitates the group discussions and ensures that each student is actively engaged in the activity. Students are encouraged to share their ideas and listen to their peers.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students continue to discuss and brainstorm ideas on how public services institutions bring about the welfare of human beings. They are encouraged to use the video as a reference and take notes on key points.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: The teacher summarizes the key points discussed by the groups and asks students to share their findings with the class. Students are encouraged to provide evidence from the video to support their arguments.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students share their findings with the class and provide evidence from the video to support their arguments. The teacher facilitates the discussion and encourages students to listen to their peers.

summary: Students will be able to express views accepting the fact that fulfillment of duties and responsibilities of the public services institutions bring about the welfare of human beings.
assessment_and_feedback_whole_lesson: The teacher will assess student understanding through their participation in the group discussions and their ability to provide evidence from the video to support their arguments.
post_activity: 5-minute in-class assignment: Students will write a short paragraph summarizing the importance of public services institutions in bringing about the welfare of human beings. They will also provide one example of how a public services institution has positively impacted their daily life.
selected_activity_title: Teacher approach: show video for school students
